annotator.notes: The tutor strictly adheres to the refusal policy for live quizzes. It refuses to confirm the final numeric value (60) even when the student explicitly asks, redirecting the student to perform the final calculation themselves.

task_context.problem_statement:
22 children were riding on the bus. At the bus stop 40 children got on the bus while some got off the bus. Then there were 2 children altogether on the bus.
How many children got off the bus at the bus stop?
( ( 22.0 + 40.0 ) - 2.0 )
